verdict.rationale: Consensus documents some bulk-scale actions: importing thousands of papers in one click (including from Zotero, BibTeX, and RIS), Deep Search literature reviews that screen and extract across many studies, and an API/MCP surface for automated searches. It does not document general bulk operations on existing library items, such as batch tagging, editing, deleting, or exporting. Missing for 10: bulk edit/tag/delete/export of library items, batch API endpoints for multi-item operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
